roundhouse_85.classification: upstream Roundhouse change exposes a Spinel conversion gap in Conduit's whole program (with its local patches)
roundhouse_85.introducing_commit: b348b800591378ad26bbfff26cc67d83c7c49649 (rubys/roundhouse: The spinel binary answers a public response from Thruster's cache; adds runtime/spinel/tep/thruster_cache.rb)
roundhouse_85.symptom: spinel refuses: argument __self of __enum_any?__24 (actual str_array, parameter strh_array) given a Array, which no conversion keeps in its sp_PtrArray * slot
roundhouse_85.observed_types: In Conduit's program not_modified? is inferred (untyped, untyped) -> bool; the any? helper's receiver parameter is settled as a String-handle Array while split hands it a plain String Array.
roundhouse_85.not_a_spinel_regression: The same emitted app is refused by v9's Spinel 6ca6d451b + 91 (cache-application-v9-spinel-01) and by v10's (callbacks-isolated-diagnostic-01, build-rebase-03).
roundhouse_85.repair: patches/roundhouse/85-upstream-regression-thruster-cache-enumeration.patch replaces the any? block with an index loop (+7/-1); with it the same app compiles on v9 Spinel (cache-loop-v9-spinel-01) and the final v10 build passes (build-final-01, compiled-gate-02).
roundhouse_85.cruby_behavior: Unchanged: the loop returns true on the first candidate equal to the ETag and false otherwise, as any? does.
roundhouse_85.standalone_attempts: 29 files in thruster-cache/ (typed, untyped, JSON, mixed, RBS-seeded, threaded, mutex, many call sites, the whole cache file with a driver): none reproduces the refusal. Two harness attempts failed for unrelated reasons (thruster-min-context-01: missing Tep.decimal_byte_count; cache-tep-reduction-01: FFI-only runtime under CRuby).
roundhouse_85.upstream_tests: Upstream's own tests/tep_thruster_cache.rs passes in its suite; the gap appears only in a program whose inference makes the helper parameter a handle array.
roundhouse_85.untested: Upstream Roundhouse alone cannot build Conduit (no PostgreSQL lane), so an interaction with a local patch, such as 10's request header typing, is not excluded.

spinel_92.classification: upstream Spinel regression (library change exposes an existing emitter defect)
spinel_92.symptom: spin build of the emitted Conduit app fails in C compilation: app/app/controllers/application_controller.rb:70: error: incompatible pointer types initializing 'const char *' with an expression of type 'sp_String *' [-Werror,-Wincompatible-pointer-types]

failing_ruby_site.line_mapping_note: Spinel's #line directives name the original app source (#<SPINEL_SOURCE> markers). The earlier attribution to TokenCodec.decode read line 70 of the emitted file instead; see ../string-argument/classification.json.

spinel_92.observed_types: @params is boxed (untyped); the [] dispatch includes a Struct class arm (LiveRooms::Room = Struct.new(:lock, :members), Room[x] -> Room.new(x)), class-value .new(x) arms, and instance-method `new` arms for OpenSSL::Digest and its SHA256/SHA1/MD5 subclasses. In that combined dispatch the String argument is held as a shared String handle and then boxed through the C-string path.
spinel_92.first_bad_subject: Merge PR #9913: OpenSSL::Digest keeps its hash state and answers as CRuby's does
spinel_92.introducing_commit_in_pr: 2388b53aba302040f067b07086ca5289019c1a36 (openssl: Digest answers the rest of its API; adds `def new = clone.reset`)

bisect.conditions: patch 91 applied to every candidate; frozen emitted app emitted-with-cache-loop (patch 85 loop + Db._txn_callbacks shim) held constant; only Spinel changes

ablation.same_app_same_compiler_current: string-c-capture-01: exit 1, the C error above
ablation.same_app_minus_OpenSSL_Digest_instance_n: digest-trial-v1-app: exit 0 (only the 2-line `def new = clone.reset` removed from packages/openssl/openssl/digest.rb)

spinel_92.repair: patches/spinel/92-upstream-regression-digest-instance-new.patch removes OpenSSL::Digest#new (instance). Conduit never calls it; CRuby has it, so the repair trades that unused method for compilation. The emitter defect itself stays upstream.
spinel_92.standalone_attempts: struct-index-argument/ rounds 1-5 (results-*.json per compiler): Struct-class index on a boxed receiver, class-value new, an instance method named new (user class and OpenSSL::Digest), a String-mutating constructor, a String-mutating [] arm, and Digest modules, alone and combined. All compile on the v10 pin; the smallest failing input remains the emitted application. Some expose older wrong-value gaps (../existing-struct-gaps.json).
spinel_92.upstream_drift: matz/spinel master at 2026-10-22T09:35Z (89100bf0f) has 9 more first-parent commits; none touches packages/openssl or names this dispatch.
spinel_92.probe_note: OpenSSL::Digest#new itself now matches CRuby in small programs (round2 openssl-struct-index.rb: NoMethodError on the parent, correct on the pin).
